method: Static requirement-to-criterion audit of frozen brief, all six notes, all five judge.toml criteria sets and prompt protocols; no configured judge or portal run made.

coverage.requirement: Workspace has editor, preview, console, new draft, and working JavaScript
Complete HTML and JS run by filename; no separate mode
Completed previews remain interactive; Stop and failed actions preserve last good
A new Run or Stop cancels pending old effects and errors
Five-second budget for loops and callbacks; usable recovery
Errors have messages and one-based entered-source lines, including HTML, timers and promises
Console levels, value inspection, history, clear, durations
Auto-run debounce, off, manual Run, queue consumption and document switch
Saved identities, duplicate titles, exact fields, reload and restart durability
Stale Save refusal, dirty draft retention, deliberate reapplication and two-editor reversal
Immutable history, read-only inspection, restore, retry, stale and concurrent operations
Snippet isolation, blocked external networking and unsupported dynamic execution, harmless words permitted
Source stored as text, not evaluated by server
Keyboard, narrow screen, editor font/line numbers/syntax color, clear appearance
Runtime entry, port, health and local persistence

gaps.requirement: Mandatory Express, better-sqlite3, Node built-ins, one local server and no external backend/database service
evidence: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:29 explicitly says its server write/read is not proof of SQLite or Express
.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:7 forbids inspection of implementation files and database bytes
gaps.plausible_passing_broken_app: A Node HTTP server with a JSON flat file or a public remote database can expose identical UI and server-backed read/write/restart behavior yet violate the stated Express/SQLite/local-backend requirement.
gaps.suggested_fix: Remove unsupported task-added technology and local-service mandates from the public note, or add an authorized deterministic implementation/runtime check outside the browser-only judge.

gaps.requirement: Restored last-good picture includes ordinary 2D canvas drawings
evidence: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:275-286 paints a canvas and tells the judge to expect the red drawing
.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:168 full-credit rollback description requires B text and changed input field but omits the painted canvas
gaps.plausible_passing_broken_app: A rollback implementation copies DOM and live input values but resets canvas bitmap pixels. It meets every observable named in cw_js_error_rollback while losing the required red drawing; Stop and timeout rollback criteria use text fixtures.
gaps.suggested_fix: Include observed canvas bitmap preservation in the existing rollback criterion full-credit bar, with the already scripted positive paint control; keep other restoration outcomes independently scored.

gaps.requirement: DB_PATH override when supplied, including a path different from /app/app.db
evidence: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/test.sh:97-110 supplies /app/app.db when /app is writable; fallback path is contingent, not a deliberate alternate-path test
.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml process-restart criterion checks readback, not override handling
gaps.plausible_passing_broken_app: An app hardcodes /app/app.db and ignores DB_PATH. In the normal writable-/app verifier branch it persists and passes restart checks because DB_PATH equals that hardcoded default.
gaps.suggested_fix: Exercise a distinct supplied DB_PATH in a task-specific, authorized runtime check while preserving the shared harness contract, or narrow the public claim to the path actually exercised.

raw_index_check.note: Hashes verify bytes only. Scripted golden observations are not configured judge, Oracle, model or portal scores.

conforming_alternative_checked: A conforming Express/SQLite implementation with server-rendered library responses, different control labels, and static restored snapshots is allowed by the browser criteria and gates; no additional false-negative conclusion is made for this coverage row.
